paper_id: Research on WebAssembly Runtimes_ A Survey
title: Research on WebAssembly Runtimes: A Survey
motivation: Wasm运行时研究快速增加，但缺乏系统性综述来整合该领域
problem_framing: 从内部(设计/测试/分析)和外部(应用场景)两个角度分类现有研究
key_insight: 首次提出将Wasm运行时研究按内部与外部双维度系统化分类
method_signature: 系统文献综述，收集98篇论文，Kitchenham流程，前向/后向滚雪球
evaluation_criteria: 应用场景分布、研究方向分布、发表 venue 分布
evidence_for_taste: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first survey
the number of papers related to Wasm runtime is rapidly increasing
we characterize existing studies from two different angles
the internal research of Wasm runtimes
the external research of Wasm runtimes
thinking_moves: 按内部/外部双维度构建分类框架，将分散的研究归入统一视角
用系统综述流程确认gap而非仅凭直觉声称贡献
通过venue分布和数据量化展示研究成熟度和多样性
将JS引擎和独立运行时都纳入Wasm运行时定义，统一研究边界
cites_own_work: Characterizing and Detecting WebAssembly Runtime Bugs (2023)
